method: Fast detector: 11-window median, residual threshold 1.15, persistence 4 and jump >1.5. Slow detector: successive 48-window median difference >0.20, five confirmations, suppress slow flags within ±70 of a fast step flag.
calibration: Eight configurations inspected on 100 calibration streams; selected 48-window threshold .20 after calibration, frozen before fresh seeds.

limitations: Thresholds tuned to known synthetic process definitions, not independent external data
